status: candidate documentary examination; accountable review pending

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

scope: Otherwise eligible government service applicant; same entitlement, purpose and lawful identity options. No real service data.

contexts.description: Individual choosing physical identification without a compatible device.
Individual choosing physical identification due to accessibility needs.
Individual declining digital enrollment irrespective of device ownership.

risk_analogies.reason: Exclusion mechanism is social-graph privilege, not service-format discrimination.
Informal discrimination is relevant, but vouching is not the SEDI service transaction.
Capacity and support exclusion are relevant only where supported decision-making is implicated.
Wallet usability risk is adjacent, not sufficient for format choice.

persona_analogies.reason: Legitimate participant encountering access barriers; different admission mechanism.
Accessibility and support needs; no assumption of minor status in the scoped cases.

reuse_review.decision: Use example-local hypotheses; no canonical IDs redefined and no canonical risk scores inherited.

hypotheses.name: Indirect or informal digital compulsion
hypotheses.harm: Loss of meaningful format choice or service access

hypotheses.name: Format-dependent service disadvantage
hypotheses.harm: Discriminatory cost, delay or reduced service

hypotheses.name: Unsupported service equivalence conclusion
hypotheses.harm: Undetected exclusion or compulsion persists under nominal assurance

cases.constructed: Both paths usable without different burdens; assume comparative evidence exists only in fixture.
cases.documentary_observation: All three requirements explicitly address the intended protection.
cases.candidate_disposition: design addresses proposition; operational effectiveness unverified
cases.evidence_needed: Matched service records, accessibility observations, current acceptance and pathway inventories.

cases.constructed: Listed physical acceptance point does not accept physical identity.
cases.documentary_observation: BOR-03 objectives 3 and 5 require coverage and review; administrative method acknowledges local discontinuation detection limit.
cases.candidate_disposition: risk addressed by stated requirement; detection effectiveness unverified
cases.evidence_needed: Current inventory, independent service point inspection, complaints and correction evidence.

cases.constructed: Staff condition otherwise lawful service on digital enrollment despite documented fallback.
cases.documentary_observation: BOR-04 objectives 4 and 5 address policy and informal compulsion; automated coverage excludes external portals.
cases.candidate_disposition: risk addressed by stated requirement; operational enforcement unverified
cases.evidence_needed: Staff practices, fallback execution, grievance accessibility and resolution evidence.

cases.constructed: Physical users experience materially longer wait or additional fees.
cases.documentary_observation: BOR-09 objectives 1–3 address service equivalence and permitted distinctions; EXPT and ADMN cannot establish all counter behavior.
cases.evidence_needed: Authoritative permitted distinctions, matched processing time and fee evidence, complaints and remediation.

cases.constructed: Documented policy parity but no comparable service observations.
cases.documentary_observation: All three verification tables explicitly delimit what their methods can establish.
cases.evidence_needed: Independent comparative service evidence and accountable interpretation of limitations.

limitations: Constructed cases are not observed incidents.
No risk severity, likelihood, guardrail result, formal finding or risk acceptance asserted.
Candidate dispositions are explanatory, not governed review statuses.
Source byte identity does not authenticate publisher release.
